antipatterns.name: SKIP_QA_FOR_INFRASTRUCTURE
antipatterns.description: Skipping visual QA testing for 'infrastructure' or 'scaffold' features
antipatterns.prevention: ALL features require step-05a-qa, even scaffolds. Visual verification catches integration issues.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Initially skipped visual testing assuming scaffold didn't need it
antipatterns.lesson: Even scaffolds need browser verification to confirm frontend-backend integration works

antipatterns.name: MANUAL_LEARNING_OUTPUT
antipatterns.description: Writing superficial 09-learn.md without updating actual learning system files
antipatterns.prevention: Step-09-learn MUST update: metrics.json, patterns.json, antipatterns.json in .nomos/learning/
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Created output file but didn't update learning infrastructure
antipatterns.lesson: Learning extraction requires updating JSON files, not just markdown

antipatterns.name: SKIP_CLEANUP_PROMPT
antipatterns.description: Not asking user about worktree cleanup when auto_mode=false
antipatterns.prevention: When cleanup_mode=false AND auto_mode=false, MUST use AskUserQuestion for cleanup decision
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Worktree left behind without asking user preference

antipatterns.name: RELATIVE_DATABASE_URL
antipatterns.description: Using relative path without file: prefix in DATABASE_URL causes CWD-dependent failures
antipatterns.prevention: Always use absolute paths with file: prefix in DATABASE_URL: file:/absolute/path/to/db.sqlite
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: DATABASE_URL=.nomos/nomos.db missing file: prefix and using relative path. @libsql/client requires file: prefix. Relative paths resolve from CWD which varies in monorepo.
antipatterns.lesson: In worktree .env setup: 1) Use WORKTREE_ROOT=$(pwd) to get absolute path, 2) Use file:${WORKTREE_ROOT}/.nomos/nomos.db format
antipatterns.fix_applied: step-00-init.md now uses absolute paths with file: prefix

antipatterns.name: DUAL_ENV_LOADING
antipatterns.description: drizzle.config.ts and packages/env load .env from different locations causing mismatches
antipatterns.prevention: drizzle.config.ts now tries multiple paths: CWD, apps/server, packages/db relative. Validation added for DATABASE_URL format.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: drizzle.config.ts hardcoded ../../apps/server/.env while packages/env loaded from CWD
antipatterns.lesson: Env loading in monorepos must handle multiple execution contexts (root, package dir, worktree)
antipatterns.fix_applied: drizzle.config.ts now tries multiple paths and validates DATABASE_URL format

antipatterns.name: BIOME_BEFORE_COMMIT
antipatterns.description: Not running Biome format check before committing leads to extra chore commits
antipatterns.prevention: Run 'bunx biome check . --write --unsafe' before committing feature code, or integrate into pre-commit hook
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: 14 Biome formatting fixes needed after initial commit, requiring a separate chore commit
antipatterns.lesson: Always format before the first commit to keep commit history clean (1 feat commit instead of feat + chore)
